name: Item
description: A flexible list row with a leading media slot (icon box, avatar or picture), a title, a description and trailing actions. The whole row can be a link or a button while its actions stay separately clickable.

children.description: ItemMedia, ItemContent and ItemActions. ItemActions is placed outside the link or button so it never nests one interactive element in another.

variant.description: default has no surface, outline adds a border, muted adds a tinted background.

size.description: sm is a compact row, md the standard row.

href.description: Makes the row a link to this address.

onPress.description: Makes the row a button, or runs on a press of the link when href is also set.

isDisabled.description: Disables the link or button part of the row. Actions keep their own state.

keyboard: Tab moves to the row when it is a link or button, then to each action
Enter activates a link row; Enter and Space activate a button row
requirements: ItemGroup is a list (role list) and each Item inside it is a listitem
A link or button row has a visible focus ring and a hover state
Actions are siblings of the link or button, never children of it, so no interactive element is nested in another
The link or button is named by its title and description; icon-only actions need a label
ItemMedia icons are decorative: the title carries the meaning
ItemSeparator is decorative inside a list and does not break the list count
screenReader: A group is announced as a list with the number of items
A link row is announced as a link with its title and description
Each action is announced by its own label

use_when: Lists of people, files, settings or notifications with an icon, text and an action
Rows that open a detail page
A compact stack of related options
avoid_when: Rows of the same fields to compare: use a table or data grid
A large selectable collection: use a list box or grid list
anti_patterns: Putting a button or link inside ItemContent when the row is already a link
Using the muted variant for every row so none stands out
